jobs.prompt: TOP PRIORITY autopilot bugs (tools/autopilot.mjs, tools/wave-pass-integrate.mjs, tools/inbox-commands.mjs, tools/journal.mjs, tools/scope-loop.mjs only if it must change; first find where the complete but not integrated blocker is raised and recorded; the blocker store is the owner or orchestrator blocker list that swarm resolve BLOCKER_ID closes). BUG 1: a resolved integrate blocker gets raised again for the same run by the autopilot. Fix: once a blocker for run RUN of kind integrate (any blocker kind keyed by run id) is resolved, it must never be raised again for that run: record the resolution durably (the blocker store keeps the resolved record with run id and kind and the autopilot checks it before raising: key = kind + run id), also when the blocker is resolved by swarm resolve, by integrating the run, by cancelling the run, or by decide; a run that is integrated, cancelled or abandoned never raises it at all. A genuinely new failure of the same run after a resolution (a different cause string) may raise a new blocker with a new id, but the identical cause never reappears. Make the check atomic with the raise (no race between two autopilot ticks). BUG 2: smoke, lane-test and probe runs must never raise complete but not integrated blockers. Mark such runs non-integrating at dispatch: a run manifest or run state field nonIntegrating: true (set by swarm doctor probes, lane smoke tests, bakeoff or eval runs, and the go flows that explicitly pass --no-integrate; find the places that dispatch smoke and lane tests: doctor, models, lane tests, evals) and by an optional manifest field integrate: false; the autopilot and the blocker code skip runs with the flag, and the off-ledger run count helper (if one exists in tools/board-data.mjs read only, do not edit board files) can read the flag. Existing runs with ids or job ids that match the smoke and probe patterns used by doctor are treated as non-integrating by a pure helper isNonIntegratingRun(state, manifest) in a new tools/run-kind.mjs; validateManifest must accept the new field. BUG 3 (autopilot, part of the same job): the warning waves under-filled (underfilledWaves in tools/board-data.mjs, a read-only function: do not edit it, call it) must make the autopilot act: when the ledger has ready tickets whose count is at least the number of free slots and the recent runs each had 1 job, the autopilot batches all ready tickets that do not conflict (no shared output files, dependencies met, not held, not sensitive-needing-review-first) into ONE wave of up to the machine worker maximum jobs instead of one ticket per run, records an Events line saying batched N tickets into one wave because waves were under-filled, and never exceeds the worker maximum or spend caps. Find where the autopilot builds a wave from ready tickets (scope-loop and go --scope) and make the batch size explicit and testable (a pure function planWaveBatch(readyTickets, { slots, ownedFiles }) in a new tools/wave-batch.mjs). Tests in tests/autopilot-blocker-resolved.test.mjs, tests/run-kind-nonintegrating.test.mjs, tests/wave-batch.test.mjs (hermetic temp project): a resolved integrate blocker is not raised again on the next ticks for the same run, also after resolve, after integrate and after cancel; an identical cause never returns, a new cause gets a new blocker; two concurrent ticks raise at most one; smoke, lane-test and probe runs (flag, field and pattern) never raise the blocker and a normal complete run still does; validateManifest accepts integrate false; planWaveBatch picks non-conflicting ready tickets up to the slot count, skips conflicts, held and unmet-dependency tickets, never exceeds slots; the autopilot tick on an under-filled history batches into one wave and logs the Events line. Keep every existing test passing (change a test only where intended behavior changes, with a comment). Never import install.mjs statically from new modules. Tests are hermetic (no ambient environment, no TTY, no network, injected clock). No token-shaped literals. ignoreTests reason: only the named files and their tests change.

jobs.prompt: Pin bug: a pinned version folder such as versions/1.47.0-44736058 under the install base reports version 1.163 when asked for its version, because the code that reports the version (swarm version, doctor, the startup banner, update checks: search for package.json reads in tools/swarm.mjs and tools/swarm/core-2.mjs line ~195, core-12.mjs, install.mjs and pins.mjs) reads the shared package.json of the install base or the checkout instead of the package.json that belongs to the running runner. Fix: the running runner reports the version of its OWN folder: derive the root from import.meta.url of the module (tools/.. of the running file) and read package.json there; if that package.json is missing, read the version from the folder name (versions/X.Y.Z-hash) and verify it is consistent; never read a package.json outside the running install folder; installs created by the installer must contain their own package.json copy (verify the installer copies it into each versions folder and never symlinks it to a shared file; if it symlinks or omits it, fix the installer and add a migration that writes the right file for existing versions folders ONLY when their folder name carries the version and the file is a symlink or missing; never overwrite a regular file). swarm version, swarm version --check, swarm pin listing and the board version badge use the same helper (runnerVersion(importMetaUrl) in a new tools/runner-version.mjs). Tests in tests/runner-version.test.mjs: a temp install base with current pointing at 1.163.0 and a versions folder 1.47.0-abc1234 holding its own package.json reports 1.47.0 when its swarm.mjs is run with node and swarm version; a versions folder whose package.json is a symlink to the shared one is repaired by the migration and reports the folder version; a regular file is never overwritten; a folder with no package.json reports the folder-name version; swarm version of current reports the current one; the pin listing shows the right version for pinned projects. Keep every existing test passing (change a test only where intended behavior changes, with a comment). Never import install.mjs statically from new modules.
